name: Bicornuate Uterus

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: American Society for Reproductive Medicine (ASRM) Classification of Müllerian Anomalies

criteria.description: Presence of a deep external fundal cleft (>10 mm) separating two uterine horns
Two endometrial cavities separated by a myometrial septum
Confirmation by imaging modalities such as 3D ultrasound, MRI, or hysterosalpingography
Lack of communication between the two endometrial cavities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of two endometrial cavities separated by a myometrial septum with a deep external fundal cleft confirmed by imaging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on imaging findings; hysteroscopy or laparoscopy may be used for confirmation.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Bicornuate uterine morphology detected on imaging
searchTerms: uterus with two horns seen on ultrasound

pathognomonic.notes: Common presenting symptom in affected women

common.notes: Often reported due to abnormal uterine shape
Increased risk due to uterine anomaly
May be associated with impaired implantation
Malpresentation such as breech is more common

occasional.notes: May occur due to uterine structural abnormalities
searchTerms: pelvic pain not linked to periods
chronic pelvic pain unrelated to cycle

rare.notes: May coexist but not directly caused by bicornuate uterus

imaging: 3D transvaginal ultrasound showing two endometrial stripes separated by a myometrial cleft
MRI demonstrating external uterine fundal indentation >10 mm with two horns
Hysterosalpingography revealing two endometrial cavities with no communication
other: Laparoscopy or hysteroscopy may confirm uterine morphology
Obstetric history of recurrent miscarriage or preterm labor

distinguishingFeatures: External uterine contour is normal (no fundal cleft)
Presence of a fibrous or muscular septum dividing the endometrial cavity
Higher risk of miscarriage but better surgical correction options
Complete duplication of uterine horns with two separate cervices
External uterine contour shows two separate uterine bodies

redFlags: Preterm labor with abnormal fetal presentation
references: American Society for Reproductive Medicine. The ASRM classification of Müllerian anomalies. Fertil Steril. 2021.
Grimbizis GF, et al. The ESHRE/ESGE consensus on the classification of female genital tract congenital anomalies. Hum Reprod. 2013.
Chan YY, et al. Reproductive outcomes in women with congenital uterine anomalies: a systematic review. Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol. 2011.
